integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial identity checks accompany a complete analytic inequality argument; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proven extension concerns the third non-Hermitian symmetric Toeplitz determinant for radial starlike mappings in the stated normalization. It does not address nonradial mappings or other determinant types. Independent literature priority remains subject to unindexed stronger results.
title: Full-order sharp bound for the third symmetric Toeplitz determinant of starlike mappings
